content.value_statement: Bugs waste engineering time when symptoms hide the real cause. This skill guides structured reproduction, isolation, root cause analysis, fixes, and regression prevention.
actual_capabilities: Collects error details, environment context, and recent code changes before analysis.
Guides users to create minimal reproducible examples for failing behavior.
Suggests isolation methods such as logging, binary search, and assumption checks.
Maps common bug patterns to practical fixes and verification steps.
Encourages regression tests and prevention steps after each fix.
limitations: Requires accurate error messages, reproduction details, or code context from the user.
Does not guarantee a fix for bugs that cannot be reproduced.
May need project-specific test commands or tooling chosen by the user.
Does not replace security review for production incident changes.

use_cases.title: Triage Runtime Errors
use_cases.description: Use a repeatable workflow to capture stack traces, recent changes, and environment details before changing code.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Intermittent Tests
use_cases.description: Investigate flaky behavior with isolation steps, race-condition checks, and targeted regression tests.

use_cases.title: Review Incident Fixes
use_cases.description: Connect symptoms to root causes, verify the fix, and document prevention steps after a production issue.

prompt_templates.title: Explain This Error
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner debugging with a clear stack trace.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me debug this error. I will share the full message, stack trace, expected result, and actual result.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Reproduction Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging when symptoms are known but not isolated.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal reproduction plan for this bug. Include inputs, setup, expected behavior, actual behavior, and isolation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Root Cause
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced analysis across recent changes and dependencies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this failing behavior and recent changes. Identify likely root causes, what evidence supports each one, and what to verify next.

prompt_templates.title: Verify and Prevent Regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed fix. Define verification steps, edge cases, regression tests, and prevention notes for future incidents.

output_examples.input: A function fails only when a user ID is missing from the data store.
output: Summary of the observed failure and expected behavior.
Likely root cause: missing empty-state handling for absent users.
Suggested fix path with validation and a regression test.

output_examples.input: A test passes locally but fails in continuous integration without a stable pattern.
output: Checklist for environment differences, timing, shared state, and dependency versions.
Isolation plan to confirm or reject a race condition.
Verification steps to prove the fix before merge.

output_examples.input: A service slows down after processing large batches for several minutes.
output: Likely causes such as retained collections or missing cleanup.
Prevention plan with profiling evidence and regression coverage.

best_practices: Start with the full error, expected behavior, actual behavior, and reproduction steps.
Change one variable at a time so each observation has a clear cause.
Add a regression test after the fix so the same bug is caught early.
anti_patterns: Changing code before reproducing the failure or reading the complete error.
Treating symptoms as root causes without checking recent changes and assumptions.
Skipping verification after a fix because the first test run passed.

faq.question: Can this skill debug any programming language?
faq.answer: It provides a language-neutral workflow and examples for common debugging tasks. Project-specific tools may still be required.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It suggests safe investigation steps, and the user controls any commands used in the project.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the full error, stack trace, expected behavior, actual behavior, reproduction steps, and recent changes.

faq.question: Can it help with intermittent bugs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes isolation steps for flaky tests, timing issues, race conditions, and environment differences.

faq.question: How does it prevent repeated bugs?
faq.answer: It recommends regression tests, edge-case checks, and documentation after the root cause is fixed.

faq.question: Is this useful for incident follow-up?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports root cause analysis, fix verification, and prevention notes after production incidents.
